mentions.name: Prompty.tools
mentions.description: A prompt engineering and management platform where users can search, store, and combine building blocks to create structured AI prompts. It is open by default so users can learn from prompts and building blocks shared by others. Planned features include an MCP integration and Claude Code plugin, a Teams tier for privately sharing prompts within a team, and LLM integration into the prompt builder that suggests suitable building blocks from a typed task description.
mentions.problem: The creator kept rewriting the same parts of prompts (or storing them in a text file) and wanted a faster way to assemble task-specific prompt elements like personas, constraints, and tones around the actual task.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Prompty.tools (http://prompty.tools), a prompt engineering and management platform where users can search, store and combine building blocks for creating structured AI prompts.
